text:
Maya Chen: Quick draft of a compact customer-facing runloop for onboarding + renewal risk ops. Would love brief reactions.
Ravi Singh: post it here pls, short bullets work best.
Maya Chen: OK, paste incoming. Core idea: capture behavioral signals -> assign risk band -> do short mitigations -> schedule enablement touch -> log feedback.
Tess Morales: Is this aimed at CSMs or onboarding engineers? we should call out who owns each step.
Maya Chen: Good point 1
- Owner: CSM for outreach + enablement; Eng-oncall for ops mitigations; CS Ops handles telemetry logging.
Evan Clarke: Add a tiny manual prefilling recipe for customers that want to self-serve. Make it copy/paste.
Maya Chen: Adding. Also adding mapping examples: 
- Signal: weekly active requests drop >30% (7d) -> Band: RED -> Action: immediate outreach, prefill warm pool, escalate if errors present.
- Signal: avg tokens per request down but counts stable -> Band: AMBER -> Action: review prompts, recommend small prompt tweak + re-run sample set.
- Signal: streaming client timeouts >3% -> Band: RED -> Action: temporary client-side rate limit + enable streaming health webhook.
Ravi Singh: For prefill, recommend staggered prefill windows to avoid overloading. Suggest: 3 waves at T0, T+10m, T+30m.
Maya Chen: Note added. Short prefilling snippet for customers: 
```bash
# lightweight staggered prefill (bash)
TENANTS=$(cat tenants.txt)
for id in $TENANTS; do
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prefill 
    -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' 
    -d '{"tenant": "'$id'", "tokens": 200}' &
  sleep 10
done
wait
```
Tess Morales: Include guidance: prefer prefix caching for chat sessions; use embedding pre-warm only for search-heavy flows.
Maya Chen: Added. Also a short batching advisory: 
- Interactive: try 25-75ms window, start batch size 4-8. 
- Bulk async: 150-400ms, batch size 16-64 depending on model.
Evan Clarke: Add quick fallback policy: if P95 latency > SLO for 2 windows OR errors spike > threshold -> route to fallback model + flag customer in CRM.
Maya Chen: Yep. Writing the exact decision rule: 
1) Detect signal -> 2) Calculate band -> 3) If RED -> trigger prefill + reduce model size if needed -> 4) If latency persists -> swap to fallback + page eng-oncall -> 5) Schedule CSM touch and capture sentiment.
Ravi Singh: For "capture sentiment" suggest short values: green/yellow/red and a one-line customer note. Makes it easily queryable.
Maya Chen: Will include. Also proposing telemetry fields to store in the cadence dashboard: time_to_first_dip, error_spike_count, streaming_pct, p95_latency_ms, last_prefill_ts.
Tess Morales: Can we have a tiny onboarding checklist for the CSM to run during the first week? one-liner bullets.
Maya Chen: Draft checklist: 
- Confirm access type (streaming vs REST)
- Confirm last prefill and batch settings
- Validate there are no recent deploy-related errors
- Run 1 sample interaction with customer and compare expected token usage
- Agree on 72h mitigation owner and follow-up
Evan Clarke: Security note: if customers enable webhook for streaming health, require either signed headers or whitelisted IPs.
Maya Chen: added security bullet + sample webhook payload for customers: 
```json
{"streaming_health_webhook":"https://hooks.redwood.ai/cs/ingest","interval_seconds":300}
```
Ravi Singh: Add instruction to tag the CRM case with "prefill-run" or "fallback-swap" so reporting picks it up.
Maya Chen: done. Also including a short SQL snippet example to compute time_to_first_dip (pseudo-SQL) for CS Ops to plug into dashboard.
Tess Morales: Keep it one screen long for CSMs. They hate long docs during calls.
Maya Chen: Will keep one-page layout. Final ask: can folks review the one-pager after I format it? planning to post to #playbooks.
Evan Clarke: I can do a quick pass tonight.
Ravi Singh: I'll review the telemetry and SQL pieces tomorrow morning.
CS Bot: Reminder: link to prefill guide: https://redwood.internal/docs/prefill and incident ref INC-2025-44.
Maya Chen: Thanks team. I'll close and ping when the formatted one-pager is up. :thumbsup:
